deadline.value: International applicants must pay and upload all documents by January 15, 2027 (portal opens October 1, 2026). Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.
deadline.quote: International applicant deadline: January 15, 2027 (payment required & supporting documentation)

supervisor.value: A willing supervisor is a key admission requirement, and your statement must show a professor's agreement; contact potential supervisors early.
supervisor.quote: A willing supervisor is a key requirement for admission to the PhD program. | We strongly recommend contacting potential supervisors early to discuss research fit, availability, and funding.

also.quote: Applicants must make clear in their written statement the agreement of a proposed supervising professor

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student is offered a minimum package for up to five years: CAD 40,000 a year in 2026-27 including tuition and fees.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the PhD program will be offered a minimum annual funding package for up to five years; provided that they are making satisfactory progress in the doctoral program. The 2026-27 minimum annual stipend is $40,000 including tuition and incidental fees

entry_route.value: Usually after a related master's (B+), or direct entry for exceptional honours BSc graduates with an A- average.
entry_route.quote: In the case of exceptional students, by direct entry, that is, after completing an honours BSc degree in a bachelor’s program in a related discipline with a minimum U of T average of A- or equivalent.

notes: PhD in Environmental Science at the Scarborough campus. The department page still says a CAD 130 fee; SGS lists CAD 135. Three academic referees.
